- **maxNestingDepth** (field) — Maximum nesting depth of objects and arrays.
- **maxObjectSize** (field) — Maximum number of keys in a single object.
- **maxDocumentSize** (field) — Maximum total length of the input document.

### class `PeerRecordVerifier`

Verifies signed peer records received from remote peers.
